reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0001 expressly states 'Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement' and preserves Customer's freedom to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties, matching the preferred position of no exclusivity on Customer.

Other 'exclusive' references identified (non-exclusive license grant in p0002, exclusive jurisdiction, trademark ownership, entire-agreement, no-third-party-beneficiary) are not exclusivity covenants binding Customer, consistent with detection guidance.
No redline or comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed; deterministic check confirms no requirements/sole-supplier obligation remains.
